message.content:
This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine. At the top, the white masthead "TEMPO" sits against a dark background with smaller white text above and below it, including the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU."

The main image shows four figures in light-colored collared shirts viewed from behind, silhouetted against a large screen. One figure in the foreground holds a dark game controller. The screen displays a pixelated scene with orange and yellow fire-like patterns. Two smaller figures are on the screen: one in a dark tactical vest and helmet floating diagonally, holding a baton and a translucent white shield with the word "POL" visible; the other figure wears a mask and holds a long, thin tool.

At the bottom, large white text reads "TANGAN JAKARTA DI PULAU REMPANG." Smaller text below mentions "Pemerintah," "Pulau Rempang," "Tomy Winata," and "Cina." A barcode, QR code, and pricing information are in the upper right corner. The overall lighting is dim, with the figures' backs lit by the screen's glow.
